sloka: तस्मिन् प्रभिन्ने त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रौ सुरासुरा भूतगणा दिशश्च ।ससागराः सर्षिमहोरागाश्च तथैव भूम्यम्बुचराश्च हृष्टाः ।। ६.५९.१४७ ।।
transliteration: tasmin prabhinne tridaśendraśatrau surāsurā bhūtagaṇā diśaśca ।sasāgarāḥ sarṣimahorāgāśca tathaiva bhūmyambucarāśca hṛṣṭāḥ ।। 6.59.147 ।।

translations.english: The enemy of Indra having been routed, the suras and asuras, the guardians of the four quarters, including the sea, the large serpents, and sages so also the creatures of land and water were joyful. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty ninth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
